main_text.p: ue aromata uti & coriandrum, ani-um, Fæniculi, Carui, nec non thy-aus & Rosmarinus, Lavendula, &c. que radices pyrethri, Zingiber, Ga-nga, &c. quod multis rationibus robare, esset, uti opinor, actum age-. Interim verbo notandum calida

ropriè loquendo esse subtiliora, ca-rem enim esse vehementiorem sub-lioris materiæ agitationem nemi-em, uti opinor, fugit; crassiora verò orpora talia denominari, quia calida orpora in sese continent, aut illorum ccasione, calida corpora in illis aut rcà illa exoriuntur, aut exoriri pos-nt: quæ propterea dicuntur calida o loquendi modo, quo Magnes dici-r trahere ferrum aut Magnetem: eo-ie sensu ferrum quamvis candens, ropriè non urit, sed hoc agere dici-r denominatione ab igneo vortice r poros ferri & circum illud rapi-ssimè acto: quæ utpote in vera Phi-sophia exercitatis manifesta, proli-xiùs

page.notes: The left edge is cropped, so the initial letters of many lines are missing; only the visible fragments are given. The first line of the second paragraph is shown as ". Interim" with a fragment of the preceding word. The catchword "xiùs" is the first word of the next page. The line "sophia" is given as "sophia" with a long s.
